expressions: /* Fn lock for the Logitech K400 family, sent by the hidout module. The messages are the table in expression 2. */ eol /* Registers used: 1 = hidout selector (bit n = send table line n; set every tick, a line goes out when its bit turns on, */ eol /* when the receiver is plugged in, and when the watch line in expression 2 matches); 6 = Fn lock state (1 or 2). */ eol /* Mapping: Power 0x00070066 -> Nothing on all layers, because the K400 sends Fn+Esc as Power and the PC would sleep. */ eol /* Fn lock at boot: 0x1 = F-keys first, 0x2 = media keys first (register 6 starts at 0, so this only runs once) */ eol 6000 recall 0 eq 0x1 6000 recall ifte 6000 store eol /* Fn+Esc (reported as Power) toggles it: on the press edge (held now, not held last tick), 6 = 3 - 6, so 1 <-> 2 */ eol 0x00070066 input_state_binary 0x00070066 prev_input_state_binary not mul eol 0x3 6000 recall sub 6000 recall ifte 6000 store eol /* selector: line 0 (0x1) or line 1 (0x2) for the state, plus line 2 (0x4) to turn on the receiver notifications */ eol 6000 recall 0x1 eq 0x1 0x2 ifte 0x4 bitwise_or 1000 store

/* hidout table for the K400 Fn lock in expression 1. Send lines: <length> <report as 32-bit words, report ID first> <targets>. */ eol /* Watch line: 0 <pattern length> <pattern words> <targets>. Lines are numbered 0, 1, 2 in order; the watch line has no number. */ eol /* Target 0x046DC52B = Logitech Unifying receiver (VID 046D, PID C52B). Keep only the lines for your keyboard. */ eol /* line 0: K400 / K400r F-keys first. 10 = HID++ short report, 01 = keyboard slot on the receiver, */ eol /* 0F = FN_INVERSION feature index (0x40A0, read from a K400r), 1A = function 1 (set) + software ID A, 00 = F-keys first */ eol 7000 0x10010F1A 0x00000000 0x046DC52B eol /* line 1: K400 / K400r media keys first: the same with 01 = media keys first */ eol 7000 0x10010F1A 0x01000000 0x046DC52B eol /* line 2: receiver, HID++ 1.0 set register 0x00 (notification flags) to 00 01 00 = wireless notifications on. */ eol /* 10 = short report, FF = the receiver itself, 80 = set short register, 00 = register 0x00. Needed for the watch line. */ eol 7000 0x10FF8000 0x00010000 0x046DC52B eol /* watch line: the receiver reports 10 01 41 ... when the device in slot 1 connects (keyboard switched on or back in range), */ eol /* and the K400 has then lost its Fn lock, so the selected lines are sent again. A disconnect matches too; harmless. */ eol 0 3000 0x10014100 0x046DC52B eol /* K400 Plus (index 09, not tested): use these two lines instead of lines 0 and 1, without the comment marks */ eol /* 7 0x10010919 0x00000000 0x046DC52B */ eol /* 7 0x10010918 0x01000000 0x046DC52B */
